title: hemionitis complanata
intro: Hemionitis complanata, commonly known as the umbrella fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe and protect the body. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis complanata include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
